# Actually Sleeping

> Actually Sleeping is a 1:1 baby and toddler sleep coaching practice for families with children from 10 weeks to 3 years. Every family gets a custom sleep plan written personally by Dr. Samantha Abrahamson (“Dr. Sam”), daily 1:1 check-ins with the coaching team, live support on Night 1, and naps coached until solid — backed by The 14-Day Sleep Guarantee. Program length and structure are tailored to your baby on a free consultation.

Key facts (as of 2026-11-09):
- Founder: Dr. Samantha Abrahamson ("Dr. Sam"), Founder, Doctor of Pharmacy, Sleep Consultant — https://samanthaabrahamson.com
- Headquarters: Coconut Grove, Florida; coaching is remote (Slack + Zoom), serving the United States
- Ages: 10 weeks to 3 years
- Families coached: 700+ (as of November 2026)
- Guarantee: The 14-Day Sleep Guarantee — "We guarantee that your baby will sleep 8–12 hours through the night within 14 days of consistent, correct implementation of your sleep plan." Full refund if not. Naps and night wake-ups coached until solid with no time limit.
- Method: custom written plan, live Night 1 support, daily 1:1 check-ins, naps coached until solid, graduation at 14+ consecutive nights. Not cry-it-out, not wait-it-out.
- Pricing: set on a free consultation based on the baby's plan; not published.
- Reviews: 129 written reviews at https://www.actuallysleeping.com/reviews/ ; Feefo verified 5.0/5 (26 in past 12 months) at https://www.feefo.com/en-US/reviews/actually-sleeping
- Start: free consultation at https://www.actuallysleeping.com
